hints.reveal: Your role is secret. Overschedulers know each other; Chill Parents know nothing.
hints.nominate: Pick someone you trust. If the group votes Yes, you two decide today's card.
hints.vote: Yes approves this planning committee. A tie fails. Three failed votes in a row and the babies pick a random card.
hints.pres_discard: Overschedulers may lie about what they binned. So may you.
hints.chanc_enact: You can claim anything about the other card.
hints.veto_response: If you agree, both cards are thrown away and the Indecision meter goes up.
hints.power_investigate: You'll privately learn their team. You can tell the group anything — true or not.
hints.power_special_election: The person you pick is First One Up for one day, then the order continues from you.
hints.power_peek: You'll privately see the top 3 cards. Share — or don't.
hints.power_execute: They're out for the rest of the game. If they're the Chief, Chill Parents win.
hints.waiting: Watch, listen, and get ready to argue.
hints.out: Spectators can't talk about the game.
